name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.8 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 14 times in 5 visits over 60 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 28 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.5 days starting 2026-06-25, at wavelengths from 1.76 to 4.96 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
